interpretation.identity_assessment: Strong practical version/build fingerprint consistent with historical Stockfish 2.0.
limitations: The checks are not a cryptographic publisher signature.
The executable download provenance was not independently established.
The SHA-256 is the locally measured executable hash, not an upstream-published checksum.
The 64-game PGN and JSONL were not supplied for independent game-by-game audit.
